entities.summary: Nicholas James David Hodgson is an English musician and songwriter, formerly of the indie rock band Kaiser Chiefs and a member of the supergroup Everyone Says Hi since 2024. Hodgson also released a solo album, Tell Your Friends, under the moniker Nick J.D. Hodgson, in 2018 and continues to write songs for other artists.
